CreateInferenceJob.description:
Before using this feature, you must grant OSS access permissions with one click on the web console and add the label `pai=plugin` to the OSS bucket you want to access. For more information, see [Add a label to an OSS bucket](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/133826.html).  
The output CSV file of the prediction job does not contain a header. Each column represents the following fields in order: `user_id`, `item_id`, `phone`, and `score`.

CreateSchedule.summary: Create a reach plan to engage and recall churned users, using the parameter settings detailed in this topic.

schema.description: The main entity of the request parameters.

ExecuteTime.description:
Execution time (UTC+8):

- If empty, execute immediately.

- If you set an execution time, set the recurrence (RepeatCycle).

GroupId.description: Group ID. For more information on how to get a group ID, see [ListGroups]().

Name.description: Reach plan name. The length is 2 to 30 characters. It supports letters, numbers, Chinese characters, and underscores (\_).

RepeatCycle.description: Recurrence. Execute based on the recurrence and recurrence unit.

RepeatCycleUnit.description:
Recurrence unit. If you specify an execution time (ExecuteTime), execute based on the recurrence unit.

- 0: Never (default).

- 1: Hour.

- 2: Day.

- 3: Week.

- 4: Month.

RepeatTimes.description:
Number of recurrences. Values are as follows:

- -1: No end time (default).

- 0: No recurrence.

- N: Stop after N recurrences.

SignName.description: Signature name. For more information on how to get a signature name, see [ListSignatures]().

SignatureId.description: Signature ID. For more information on how to get a signature ID, see [ListSignatures]().

TemplateCode.description: Template Code. For more information on how to get a template Code, see [ListTemplates]().

TemplateId.description: The ID or code of the template. For more information, see [ListTemplates](~~413414~~).

PaymentType.description:
Billing type (defaults to pay-as-you-go if empty). Values are as follows:

- PayAsYouGo: Pay-as-you-go

- Subscription: Subscription

- MixPay: Mixed payment
